map.统计字数、行数、话题数，支持 1000 字上限提醒。: Count characters, lines and hashtags, with a 1000-character limit reminder.
map.小红书字数统计：字符数 = 文本长度、行数 = 非空行数、话题数 = # 标签个: Xiaohongshu character counting: characters = text length, lines = non-empty lines, hashtags = number of # tags; remaining allowance = limit − characters, and exceeding it triggers a warning.
map.录入多篇笔记的赞/藏/评/粉，汇总与算均值。: Enter likes, saves, comments and followers for several posts, then total and average them.
map.对比不同选题的平均互动找爆款方向。: Compare average engagement across topics to find breakout directions.
map.跟踪账号粉丝增长与单篇表现。: Track account follower growth and individual post performance.
map.录入 30 篇笔记：赞藏合计 45000、评论 6000、粉丝净增 8000 →: Entering 30 posts: 45000 likes and saves, 6000 comments and 8000 net new followers gives 1700 interactions per post, with 3 breakout posts taking 30% of traffic, so review their topics.
map.某篇赞 3000、粉 10000 → 赞粉比 30%，高于账号均值 17%，内容: One post with 3000 likes against 10000 followers gives a like-to-follower ratio of 30%, above the account average of 17%, so its content quality beats the overall account.
map.计数能替代平台后台吗？: Can counting replace the platform backend?
map.不能。本工具是手动/导出汇总辅助，以平台官方数据为准，适合做跨笔记对比。: No. This tool is a manual or export aggregation aid; official platform data prevails, and it suits cross-post comparison.
map.赞粉比有什么用？: What is the like-to-follower ratio for?
map.粗略看内容撬动新粉效率，比值高说明内容破圈拉新强，低则说明多为老粉互动。: It roughly shows how efficiently content wins new followers: a high ratio means the content broke out and drew new users, a low one means existing followers did most of the interacting.
